#define INIT_TASK(name) {                                             \
    .state         = 0,                                               \
    .stack         = (struct thread_info *)__get_free_pages(GFP_KERNEL, THREAD_SIZE_ORDER), \
    .usage         = ATOMIC_INIT(2),                                  \
    .flags         = 0,                                               \
    .prio          = DEFAULT_PRIO,                                    \
    .static_prio   = DEFAULT_PRIO,                                    \
    .normal_prio   = DEFAULT_PRIO,                                    \
    .policy        = SCHED_NORMAL,                                    \
    .nr_cpus_allowed = 1,                                             \
    .cpus_allowed  = CPU_MASK(0),                                     \
    .mm            = NULL,                                            \
    .active_mm     = &init_mm,                                        \
    .se            = {                                                \
        .run_node  = LIST_HEAD_INIT((name).se.run_node),            \
    },                                                                \
    .real_parent   = &tasks,                                          \
    .parent        = &tasks,                                          \
    .children      = LIST_HEAD_INIT((name).children),                \
    .sibling       = {                                                \
        .prev      = &((name).sibling),                               \
        .next      = &((name).sibling),                               \
    },                                                                \
    .group_leader  = &name,                                           \
    .tty           = NULL,                                            \
    .fs            = &init_fs,                                        \
    .files         = &init_files,                                     \
    .signal        = &init_signals,                                   \
    .sighand       = &init_sighand,                                   \
    .nsproxy       = &init_nsproxy,                                   \
    .thread        = {                                                \
        .task_struct = &name,                                         \
    },                                                                \
    .cpu_timers    = {                                                \
        .next      = NULL,                                            \
        .prev      = NULL,                                            \
    },                                                                \
    .exit_list     = LIST_HEAD_INIT((name).exit_list),               \
    .cpu           = 0,                                                \
    .thread_group_leader = 1,                                         \
    .pid           = 0,                                                \
    .tgid          = 0,                                                \
    .cred          = &init_cred,                                      \
    .real_cred     = &init_cred,                                      \
}
